### Aristotle on choice

Aristotle (384–322 BCE) approaches choice within Peripatetic. Aristotle pursued demonstrative science grounded in observation, definition, and causal explanation. His Organon developed syllogistic logic and standards of proof that structured Western reasoning for two millennia. On this page, the archive isolates English passages where that project meets choice most directly—useful for searches such as “aristotle quotes on choice.”
